zones.message: The renderer has no Node.js. Reach the main process through the preload bridge on `window.gnotes`.
The preload bundle is not importable from the renderer; its only surface is what `contextBridge` exposes.
The main process has no DOM. Move anything both sides need into `src/shared`.
Preload and main are separate bundles. Share code through `src/shared` instead.
Preload runs in the renderer's process and must not pull in main-process code (or the Node modules behind it).
Preload runs before the app does and must not import renderer code.
